Maya R.: morning — saw repeated p95 blasts on rack-12 starting 09:02 UTC. Small-latency tenants (chat-lite) hit 3x tail. Traced to tenant `video-train` doing large host<->GPU sync copies.
Evan L.: yep. `sar` + `nvidia-smi dmon` show sustained mem bw and tx queue buildup on eth0. NIC tx queue depth up -> kernel qdisc backlog.
Sofia N.: recurring pattern. We have three levers: 1) soft-carveout (fractional reserved slice), 2) per-tenant egress shaping (eBPF/qdisc), 3) SLO-aware auto-eviction to warm pool. Tradeoffs: cost, cache loss, complexity.
Diego M.: proto for egress shaping: token-bucket per-tenant with large burst then low sustained rate. preserves small RPCs. Branch: `egress-shape/per-tenant-token`.
Maya R.: can we automate detection -> soft-move? e.g. if tenant p95>200ms AND egressMbps>250 for 2m then soft-move to reserved fraction 0.25.
Evan L.: yes. Router policy prototype (RFC):
```
# router policy example (pseudo)
cond: tenant.metrics.p95_ms > 200 && tenant.nic_tx_rate_mb > 250
action: soft_move(tenant, reserve_fraction=0.25, reason="egress-surge")
```
Also metric: `sum(rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total[1m])) by (tenant) > 250000000`
Sofia N.: Product question: what do we charge for a fractional slice? current Dedicated SKU assumes whole GPU. Need a pricing proposal for fractional (25/50%).
Diego M.: short term ops plan: roll per-tenant eBPF shaping to us-west edge as a canary for 20m, watch chat-lite p95 and nic_queue_depth. If good, enable auto-creation of reserved slice and notify billing.
Maya R.: ops-bot please open an incident and create alerts for nic_queue_depth and tenant_egress_rate threshold.
ops-bot: INC-2026-043 opened for rack-12 noisy-tenant + soft-carveout exploration. Owner: Diego M.
deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled: `egress-shape/per-tenant-token` -> target: us-west-edge-rackpool-2. TTL: 20m.
Evan L.: quick command if we need immediate manual move: `curl -XPOST $ROUTER/admin/move -d '{"tenant":"video-train","to":"reserved-fraction-0.25"}'` (this preserves ephemeral cache? no, it triggers pod reschedule -> cache drop).
Sofia N.: note on UX: Console should show "soft-carveout" events and estimated cost delta before applying. I'll file a product ticket.
Diego M.: monitoring dashboards added for canary. If 95p queue depth drops >50% and chat-lite p95 returns to baseline -> mark success and schedule roll.
Maya R.: TL;DR plan: 1) manual soft-move if repeats today, 2) canary eBPF shaping in us-west, 3) SLO-aware auto-soft-move prototype, 4) product pricing work for fractional slices. Sync at 1700 UTC.
Sofia N.: thanks. Please add a quick runbook step: when soft-move happens, inform tenant with "performance-protection" tag so they can opt into reserved slice.
Evan L.: adding runbook note. Will also add a metric to detect repeated host-copy patterns (nvlink/dma flurry).
Diego M.: starting canary in 2m.
ops-bot: INC-2026-043 updated: canary in progress.
Maya R.: thanks all. We'll keep INC open until pricing + auto rule decisions are in place. :thumbsup:
